camel_example: aliyun ice GetDemonstrationForCustomizedVoiceJob --region cn-hangzhou --Scenario story --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Retrieves the text and sample audio required to train a personalized voice
description_zh: 通过本接口来获取训练个性化人声所需要朗读的文本及示例音频
name: GetDemonstrationForCustomizedVoiceJob

parameters.help_en:
The demonstration scenario. Valid values:

story: Story.
interaction: Interaction.
navigation: Navigation
parameters.help_zh:
示范场景。

可以取以下的一个值：

story：故事
interaction：交互
navigation：导航
parameters.name: scenario

DemonstrationList.description_en: The demonstration list, which returns 20 text passages to be read aloud and their corresponding audio samples
DemonstrationList.description_zh: 示范列表，返回 20 条需要朗读的文本及对应语音示例

AudioId.description_en: The sequence number of the text, which corresponds to the AudioRecordId field that must be passed during audio detection
AudioId.description_zh: 该文本的序号，对应音频检测时需要传入的 AduioRecordId 字段

DemoAudio.description_en:
The URL of the sample audio.
OSS URL.
<notice>The audio file expires in 12 hours.</notice>
DemoAudio.description_zh:
示例音频 URL
OSS 地址
<notice>音频文件过期时间为 12 小时></notice>

Text.description_en: The text content to be read aloud
Text.example: 不行，他想了一下，我不能这样对国王说，这是在撒谎。

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功，取值：
true：成功
false：失败
